text:
noah: FYI during the gpu onboarding window (asia-east) we saw a short burst of etcd leader elections and apiserver 503s around 03:11 UTC. Noticed via dashboard.

tariq: Confirmed. leader-changes=4 in 9m, etcd commit latency jumped to ~95ms. apiserver watch reconnects spiked.

meera: We did a rapid node scale-up (~30 GPUs) starting 03:00. kube-proxy conntrack counters were high. Could be SNAT/ephemeral exhaustion.

frank: Pulled cloud-NAT metrics: snat_port_util=0.92, conntrack_used=0.97 at 03:09. That'll cause TCP resets and broken raft heartbeats.

ops-bot: ticket=INFRA-5230 created owner=infra-net summary="SNAT/conntrack pressure -> etcd leader churn during GPU onboarding" at=2026-04-07T03:15:00Z

noah: Short-term mitigation: pause autoscaler, request extra NAT IPs, rollback any onboarding firewall changes.

tariq: Paused autoscaler and requested +2 NAT IPs. After pause leader flips stopped within ~4m and apiserver errors dropped.

meera: Cost note: extra re-lists/watch reconnects estimated ~5k token-equivalents during the incident. Filing follow-up for cost reclamation.

frank: Long-term: add autoscaler pacing for GPU pools, preflight NAT capacity check, and an alert at 75% conntrack usage. Also consider prefix KV caching during high churn.

noah: Agreed. Adding runbook entry and scheduling a 30m retro tomorrow. Closing unless regressions seen.
